77PAPER_CORRECTED_orthogonal candidate = torch.randn((dim, dim), generator=generator, dtype=dtype)

79PAPER_CORRECTED_orthogonal signs = torch.where(torch.diagonal(r) < 0, -1.0, 1.0).to(dtype)

268ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm return
269ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm if len(configured) != len(model.model.layers):
270ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm raise ValueError("one RoPE BlockPerm order table is required per decoder layer")
271ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm for layer, layer_orders in zip(model.model.layers, configured, strict=True):
272ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm orders = torch.tensor(layer_orders, dtype=torch.int64)
273ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm expected = (model.config.num_key_value_heads, layer.self_attn.head_dim // 2)
274ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm if tuple(orders.shape) != expected:
275ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm raise ValueError(

279ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTEinstall_synchronized_blockperm "aloepri_block_orders", orders, persistent=True

24ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifestdef _verify_key_manifest(path: Path) -> None:
25ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest candidates = (path / "manifest.json", path / "key_manifest.json")
26ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest manifest_path = next((candidate for candidate in candidates if candidate.is_file()), None)
27ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if manifest_path is None:
28ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest return
29ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
30ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest records = manifest.get("files")
31ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if not isinstance(records, list):
32ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest raise ValueError(f"key manifest has no files list: {manifest_path.name}")
33ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest declared: set[str] = set()
34ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest for record in records:
35ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if not isinstance(record, dict) or not isinstance(record.get("path"), str):
36ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest raise ValueError(f"key manifest contains an invalid file record: {manifest_path.name}")
37ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest relative = Path(record["path"])
38ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if relative.is_absolute() or relative.name != record["path"] or ".." in relative.parts:
39ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest raise ValueError(f"key manifest contains an unsafe path: {record['path']}")
40ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest declared.add(record["path"])
41ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest target = path / relative
42ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if not target.is_file() or target.stat().st_size != int(record["bytes"]):
43ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest raise ValueError(f"key manifest size mismatch: {record['path']}")
44ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest digest = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
45ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if digest != record["sha256"]:
46ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest raise ValueError(f"key manifest hash mismatch: {record['path']}")
47ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if manifest_path.name == "manifest.json":
48ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest actual = {
49ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest item.name
50ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest for item in path.iterdir()
51ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if item.is_file() and item.name != manifest_path.name
52ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest }
53ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest if actual != declared:
54ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest raise ValueError(
55ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest "key manifest file set mismatch: "
56ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest f"declared={sorted(declared)}, actual={sorted(actual)}"
57ENGINEERING_SUBSTITUTE_verify_key_manifest )

6PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encodedef frequency_rank_encode(sequence: list[int]) -> list[int]:
7PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encode """Replace symbols by frequency rank; ties use first occurrence then symbol id."""
8PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encode counts = Counter(sequence)
9PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encode first = {token: sequence.index(token) for token in counts}
10PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encode ordered = sorted(counts, key=lambda token: (-counts[token], first[token], token))
11PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encode rank = {token: index + 1 for index, token in enumerate(ordered)}
12PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDfrequency_rank_encode return [rank[token] for token in sequence]

149PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_productdef qk_cross_product(
150PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product left_embedding: torch.Tensor,
151PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product right_embedding: torch.Tensor,
152PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product q_weight: torch.Tensor,
153PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product k_weight: torch.Tensor,
154PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product *,
155PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product num_heads: int,
156PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product num_kv_heads: int,
157PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product head_dim: int,
158PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product) -> torch.Tensor:
159PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product if num_heads % num_kv_heads:
160PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product raise ValueError("num_heads must be divisible by num_kv_heads")

162PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product key = (right_embedding @ k_weight.mT).reshape(-1, num_kv_heads, head_dim)

164PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDqk_cross_product return query.flatten(1) @ key.flatten(1).mT

24PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain tau = load_file(args.key_dir / "paper_key.safetensors", device="cpu")["tau"]
25PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
26PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20260803)
27PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain plain_ids = torch.randperm(tau.numel(), generator=generator)[: args.sample]
28PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain private_ids = tau[plain_ids]
29PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain private_ids = private_ids[torch.randperm(args.sample, generator=generator)]
30PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain private_position = {int(token): index for index, token in enumerate(private_ids)}
31PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain truth = torch.tensor([private_position[int(tau[token])] for token in plain_ids], device=device)
32PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain original_embedding = (
33PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain load_tensor(args.original, "model.embed_tokens.weight")[plain_ids].float().to(device)
34PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain )
35PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain private_embedding = (
36PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain load_tensor(args.private, "model.embed_tokens.weight")[private_ids].float().to(device)
37PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain )
38PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain known_features = []
39PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain observed_features = []
40PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain for layer in args.layers:
41PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain norm = (
42PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain load_tensor(
43PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain args.original,
44PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain f"model.layers.{layer}.post_attention_layernorm.weight",
45PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain )
46PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain .float()
47PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain .to(device)
48PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain )
49PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain original_gate = (
50PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain load_tensor(args.original, f"model.layers.{layer}.mlp.gate_proj.weight")
51PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain .float()
52PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain .to(device)
53PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain )
54PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain private_gate = (
55PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain load_tensor(args.private, f"model.layers.{layer}.mlp.gate_proj.weight")
56PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain .float()
57PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain .to(device)
58PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain )
59PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain known_features.append(gate_invariant_features(original_embedding, norm, original_gate))
60PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain observed_features.append((private_embedding @ private_gate.mT).mean(1))
61PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain known = torch.stack(known_features, dim=1)
62PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain observed = torch.stack(observed_features, dim=1)
63PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain center = torch.cat((known, observed)).mean(0)
64PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain scale = torch.cat((known, observed)).std(0).clamp_min(1e-8)
65PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain known = (known - center) / scale
66PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain observed = (observed - center) / scale
67PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain distance = torch.cdist(known, observed)
68PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain prediction = distance.argmin(1)
69PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain top10 = distance.topk(min(10, args.sample), largest=False).indices

74PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDmain "sample_size": args.sample,

52PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery predicted: Tensor,
53PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery true_plain_ids: Tensor,
54PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery baseline_embedding: Tensor,
55PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery *,
56PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery topk: int,

58PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery) -> dict[str, float]:
59PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery """Rank the full vocabulary in chunks and report token recovery and cosine fit."""

61PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery flat_prediction = predicted.reshape(-1, predicted.shape[-1])
62PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery flat_truth = true_plain_ids.reshape(-1).to(flat_prediction.device)
63PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery normalized_prediction = nn.functional.normalize(flat_prediction, dim=1)
64PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery k = min(topk, baseline_embedding.shape[0])
65PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery best_scores = torch.empty((flat_prediction.shape[0], 0), device=flat_prediction.device)
66PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery best_ids = torch.empty(
67PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery (flat_prediction.shape[0], 0), dtype=torch.int64, device=flat_prediction.device
68PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery )
69PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery for start in range(0, baseline_embedding.shape[0], chunk_size):
70PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery candidates = baseline_embedding[start : start + chunk_size].to(flat_prediction.device)
71PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery scores = normalized_prediction @ nn.functional.normalize(candidates, dim=1).mT
72PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery candidate_scores, candidate_positions = torch.topk(scores, min(k, scores.shape[1]), dim=1)
73PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery candidate_ids = candidate_positions + start
74PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery merged_scores = torch.cat((best_scores, candidate_scores), dim=1)
75PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery merged_ids = torch.cat((best_ids, candidate_ids), dim=1)
76PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery best_scores, selected = torch.topk(merged_scores, min(k, merged_scores.shape[1]), dim=1)
77PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery best_ids = torch.gather(merged_ids, 1, selected)
78PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery truth_embedding = baseline_embedding[flat_truth.cpu()].to(flat_prediction.device)
79PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery cosine = nn.functional.cosine_similarity(flat_prediction, truth_embedding, dim=1)
80PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery return {
81PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery "token_top1_recovery_rate": float((best_ids[:, 0] == flat_truth).float().mean()),
82PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery "token_topk_recovery_rate": float((best_ids == flat_truth[:, None]).any(1).float().mean()),
83PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery "embedding_cosine_similarity": float(cosine.mean()),
84PAPER_UNDERSPECIFIEDtopk_embedding_recovery }

38PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery prior_counts: torch.Tensor,
39PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery observed_counts: torch.Tensor,

41PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery observed_private_ids: torch.Tensor,

43PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery) -> float:

55PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery local_distance, min(k, local_distance.numel()), largest=False
56PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery ).indices
57PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery candidates = sorted_plain_ids[start:end][selected]
58PROXY_NOT_PAPER_EXACTtopk_frequency_recovery correct += int(bool((candidates == inverse_tau[private_id]).any()))

23VERIFICATIONsha256_filedef sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
24VERIFICATIONsha256_file digest = hashlib.sha256()
25VERIFICATIONsha256_file with path.open("rb") as handle:
26VERIFICATIONsha256_file for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
27VERIFICATIONsha256_file digest.update(block)
28VERIFICATIONsha256_file return digest.hexdigest()

18VERIFICATIONmain )

26VERIFICATIONmain args = parser.parse_args()

30VERIFICATIONmain tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.tokenizer, local_files_only=True)
31VERIFICATIONmain key = load_file(args.key_dir / "paper_key.safetensors", device="cpu")
32VERIFICATIONmain tau = key["tau"]
33VERIFICATIONmain excluded = set(int(value) for value in tokenizer.all_special_ids)
34VERIFICATIONmain candidates = torch.tensor(
35VERIFICATIONmain [index for index in range(tau.numel()) if index not in excluded], dtype=torch.int64
36VERIFICATIONmain )
37VERIFICATIONmain generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(args.seed)
38NON_EXECUTABLEmain
39VERIFICATIONmain random_results = []
40VERIFICATIONmain counterexamples: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
41VERIFICATIONmain for length in args.lengths:
42VERIFICATIONmain failures = 0
43VERIFICATIONmain for _ in range(args.samples_per_length):
44VERIFICATIONmain positions = torch.randint(
45VERIFICATIONmain 0, candidates.numel(), (length,), generator=generator, dtype=torch.int64
46VERIFICATIONmain )
47VERIFICATIONmain ids = candidates[positions].tolist()
48VERIFICATIONmain text = tokenizer.decode(
49VERIFICATIONmain ids, skip_special_tokens=False, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False
50VERIFICATIONmain )
51VERIFICATIONmain reencoded = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
52VERIFICATIONmain if reencoded != ids:
53VERIFICATIONmain failures += 1
54VERIFICATIONmain if len(counterexamples) < 20:
55VERIFICATIONmain counterexamples.append(
56VERIFICATIONmain {

60VERIFICATIONmain "reencoded_ids": reencoded,
61VERIFICATIONmain }
62VERIFICATIONmain )
63VERIFICATIONmain random_results.append(

69VERIFICATIONmain }
70VERIFICATIONmain )

75VERIFICATIONmain if not isinstance(prompt_values, list):

79VERIFICATIONmain plain_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt, add_special_tokens=False)
80VERIFICATIONmain private_ids = tau[torch.tensor(plain_ids, dtype=torch.int64)].tolist()
81VERIFICATIONmain private_text = tokenizer.decode(
82VERIFICATIONmain private_ids,
83VERIFICATIONmain skip_special_tokens=False,
84VERIFICATIONmain clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False,
85VERIFICATIONmain )

87VERIFICATIONmain prompt_results.append(
